Demo contains:

The demo can also be played over a local network.

notes.title: Cancel edit mode.
notes.notes: Unfortunately during the development process, it was decided to cut the map editor. I apologize and apologize to those who were waiting for him.

notes.title: Adventure mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36136665/3ac28682588b3f61e8392247916f2946ba3b21b5.png[/img]
1/2 Adventure mode is ready.
In this update:
- 48 adventure levels
- 6 bosses
-3 new weapons (for Dungeon)
- 2 difficulty modes
- small arena fixes

notes.title: Localization
notes.notes:
Hi there. The game now has language support

-English
-Русский (Russian)
-Deutsch (German)
-Français (French)
-Español - España (Spanish - Spain)
-Italiano (Italian)
-Norsk (Norwegian)
-Polski (Polish)
-Português (Portuguese)
-日本語 (Japanese)
-한국어 (Korean)

As well as more convenient graphics settings.
